team_invites_select_invitee.name: team_invites_select_invitee
team_invites_select_invitee.using: "team_invites"."email" = lower((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'email') and (select private.is_anon()) is false

run_summary_sections_select_own.name: run_summary_sections_select_own
run_summary_sections_select_own.using: exists (select 1 from public.run_summaries s where s.id = "run_summary_sections"."summary_id" and s.user_id = (select auth.uid())) and (select private.is_anon()) is false

schedules_meta_insert_own.name: schedules_meta_insert_own
schedules_meta_insert_own.withCheck: (select auth.uid()) = "schedules_meta"."user_id" and (select private.is_anon()) is false and (select private.has_feature('schedules'))

schedules_meta_update_own.name: schedules_meta_update_own
schedules_meta_update_own.withCheck: (select auth.uid()) = "schedules_meta"."user_id" and (select private.is_anon()) is false and (select private.has_feature('schedules'))

app_config_bounds.name: app_config_bounds
app_config_bounds.value:
jsonb_typeof("app_config"."value") <> 'number' or (
        ("app_config"."min_value" is null or ("app_config"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric >= "app_config"."min_value")
        and ("app_config"."max_value" is null or ("app_config"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric <= "app_config"."max_value"))

public.latest_app_releases.definition: select distinct on ("app_releases"."platform", "app_releases"."channel") "id", "platform", "channel", "version", "severity", "reason", "min_native_version", "published_at" from "app_releases" order by "app_releases"."platform", "app_releases"."channel", "app_releases"."published_at" desc, "app_releases"."id" desc
public.latest_app_releases.name: latest_app_releases
